title: Dilwala
desc: A joint family gets separated when the eldest son marries his employer's daughter and the second son decides to go abroad. The youngest son takes care of his parents and brings the family together.

title: Farishta
desc: A father rejects his son with a mental disability and sends him to prison. However, years later the father and son reunite during a troubling time in their lives.

title: Mere Chachu Ki Shaadi
desc: A saloon mishap has a young man struggling to gain the attention of his crush. However, when they finally get together, the journey isn't as easy as they thought it would be.

title: Akshara
desc: After marrying Vijay, Akshara persuades her grandmother to let her continue teaching. With Vijay's support, she secures a job at a government school, which happens to be near an international school.

title: Rishton Ka Batwara
desc: Members in a family argue over property claims and take each other to court. However, this dispute drives a wedge in their relationships which affects future generations.

title: Adalat
desc: A young man and his trusted friend, who is a professional journalist, stand up to some gangsters and try to take them down.

title: Main Rani Himmatwali
desc: A woman takes the responsibility of protecting her village from the tyrannical rule of the evil landlord and his malevolent henchmen.
